comparison.objective: Open a loaded shelf-ready tray by tearing off its front panel along perforations.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-and-peel force control on a constrained tear path.
comparison.success_condition: Panel fully removed while the tray stays nearly fixed, cans remain upright and contained, and no off-perforation tear occurs.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled tearing of packaging, not orientation-sensitive loose-body sieving.
